title: 無架空線輕軌供電~Catenary-free light-rail power systems
focus: 區分分段地面供電與車載儲能的無架空線系統~Distinguishing segmented ground supply from onboard energy storage
summary: 本課聚焦區分分段地面供電與車載儲能的無架空線系統。從輪周功率與電源需求建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把輔助供電的跨區續航與電源模式交接時序連成可驗證的介面，最後以線路服務與設備修復整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies distinguishing segmented ground supply from onboard energy storage. Start with wheel power and supply demand to define physical or information boundaries, connect auxiliary backup across supply gaps with power-mode handoff timing as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through line service and equipment recovery. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2003 年波爾多無架空線地面供電開始使用。；2018 年伊斯坦堡地面供電供應案對外公告。；2021 年伊斯坦堡地面供電路段開始營運。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對區分分段地面供電與車載儲能的無架空線系統而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用回生能量與接收邊界及潮濕污損與模式案例連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2003: Bordeaux began using ground-level catenary-free tram power. 2018: An Istanbul ground-level-power supply project was announced. 2021: The Istanbul ground-level-power section entered passenger service. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For distinguishing segmented ground supply from onboard energy storage, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through regeneration and receiving boundaries and wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪周功率與電源需求。原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。公式 y=(m*a+R)*v/1000，代入得 y=1800 kW。邊界：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。敏感度只改 m=180000 至 198000 kg，輸出變為 1962 kW；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究回生能量與接收邊界：原創假想教學輸入：等效質量 m=180000 kg；速度 v=22 m/s；回收效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6，代入得 y=8.47 kWh。邊界：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先以車輛加速和阻力建立輪周機械功率，再另列供電轉換與輔機損失。比較同速度下不同載重需求，不把車載電流直接等同於有效牽引力。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel power and supply demand. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=(m*a+R)*v/1000 gives y=1800 kW. Boundary: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted. For sensitivity, change only m=180000 to 198000 kg; the output becomes 1962 kW. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate regeneration and receiving boundaries: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent mass m=180000 kg; speed v=22 m/s; recovery efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6 gives y=8.47 kWh. Boundary: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Establish wheel mechanical power from acceleration and resistance before accounting for conversion and auxiliary losses. Compare loads at the same speed without treating supply current as effective tractive effort. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 輪周功率與電源需求~Wheel power and supply demand
units.title: 輪周功率與電源需求~Wheel power and supply demand
units.mechanism: 先以車輛加速和阻力建立輪周機械功率，再另列供電轉換與輔機損失。比較同速度下不同載重需求，不把車載電流直接等同於有效牽引力。牽引力先克服阻力，剩餘部分才增加列車動量。輪周機械功率等於牽引力乘速度，因此低速大力不必然等於高功率；電源側功率另受效率、輔助負載及回生可受納性影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。~Establish wheel mechanical power from acceleration and resistance before accounting for conversion and auxiliary losses. Compare loads at the same speed without treating supply current as effective tractive effort. Traction force first overcomes resistance; the remainder changes train momentum. Mechanical power at the wheel equals force times speed, so a large low-speed force need not imply high power. Electrical input also depends on efficiency, auxiliaries and regenerative receptivity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。公式 y=(m*a+R)*v/1000，代入得 y=1800 kW。邊界：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=(m*a+R)*v/1000 gives y=1800 kW. Boundary: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted.
units.verify: 將速度與牽引力同步取樣，對照加速度反推的慣性力，並另列輔助設備耗電。以「輪周功率與電源需求」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Synchronize speed and traction-force samples, compare inertial force inferred from acceleration, and account separately for auxiliary consumption. For wheel power and supply demand, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把電網輸入功率直接當成輪周功率會高估加速能力，低速輪滑亦可使電流很高而車速不升。回到「輪周功率與電源需求」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating grid input as wheel power overstates acceleration capability; low-speed slip can produce high current without increasing train speed. Trace the input chain for wheel power and supply demand. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快~Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration.
units.practice: 只把列車質量 m 從 180000 改成 198000 kg（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1800 變為 1962 kW。先說明「輪周功率與電源需求」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only train mass m from 180000 to 198000 kg (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1800 to 1962 kW. Explain the causal direction for wheel power and supply demand, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 回生能量與接收邊界~Regeneration and receiving boundaries
units.title: 回生能量與接收邊界~Regeneration and receiving boundaries
units.mechanism: 把列車動能上限、轉換效率和接收能力分開，辨認能量究竟回到電網還是車載儲能。接收端不可用時不能假設全部回收，能量帳仍要列出耗散去向。回生能量的上限先受列車動能限制，再受轉換損失與受電端容量限制。速度平方決定動能量級，回生率不能單獨說明整趟能耗；若鄰車或儲能無法接收，原可回收的能量仍可能轉為電阻熱。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。~Separate kinetic-energy limit, conversion efficiency and receptivity, identifying grid and onboard storage as different receivers. When reception is unavailable, retain the dissipation path instead of assuming complete recovery. Recoverable energy is bounded first by kinetic energy and then by conversion losses and receiver capacity. The square of speed sets the energy scale, while recovery efficiency alone cannot describe journey consumption. Energy may still become resistor heat when nearby trains or storage cannot accept it. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：等效質量 m=180000 kg；速度 v=22 m/s；回收效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6，代入得 y=8.47 kWh。邊界：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent mass m=180000 kg; speed v=22 m/s; recovery efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6 gives y=8.47 kWh. Boundary: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate.
units.verify: 比較電機側與直流母線能量積分，分開記錄制動電阻消耗與儲能充電。以「回生能量與接收邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare integrated machine-side and DC-bus energy, keeping braking-resistor dissipation distinct from energy stored. For regeneration and receiving boundaries, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。回到「回生能量與接收邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure. Trace the input chain for regeneration and receiving boundaries. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 有回生制動的列車就不會產生任何制動熱~A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat.
units.practice: 只把速度 v 從 22 改成 24.2 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 8.47 變為 10.2487 kWh。先說明「回生能量與接收邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only speed v from 22 to 24.2 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 8.47 to 10.2487 kWh. Explain the causal direction for regeneration and receiving boundaries, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 導體接觸的電阻損失~Resistive losses in conductors and contacts
units.title: 導體接觸的電阻損失~Resistive losses in conductors and contacts
units.mechanism: 在理想直流回路中以電流平方比較電阻損失，區分有用牽引功率與局部發熱。接觸劣化會改變電阻與熱點位置，量測需同時保留電流和壓降。直流饋電與接觸路徑的電阻損耗與電流平方成正比，所以尖峰電流對發熱特別敏感。等效電阻可包含導線與接點，卻不能把各部位的散熱條件視為相同；平均總損耗正常仍可能有局部接點過熱，分段供電的安全狀態也不是由此功率公式決定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：理想穩態直流電阻損耗，未提供地面供電分段邏輯或現場帶電作業方法。~Use current squared to compare resistive loss in an ideal DC path, separating useful traction power from local heating. Retain current and voltage-drop measurements as contact deterioration changes resistance and hotspot location. Resistive loss in a DC feeder and contact path scales with current squared, making peak current particularly influential. Equivalent resistance may include conductors and contacts, but their cooling conditions differ. A normal total loss can coexist with a hot contact, and the safe state of segmented supply is not determined by this power equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Ideal steady DC resistance loss, without ground-supply segmentation logic or live electrical work procedures.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：假想直流電流 I=200 A；等效回路電阻 R=0.03 ohm。公式 y=I*I*R/1000，代入得 y=1.2 kW。邊界：理想穩態直流電阻損耗，未提供地面供電分段邏輯或現場帶電作業方法。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: assumed direct current I=200 A; equivalent circuit resistance R=0.03 ohm. Formula y=I*I*R/1000 gives y=1.2 kW. Boundary: Ideal steady DC resistance loss, without ground-supply segmentation logic or live electrical work procedures.
units.verify: 在隔離低壓台同時量測電流與電壓降，核對功率帳後以溫度分布尋找局部接觸電阻異常。以「導體接觸的電阻損失」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure current and voltage drop together on an isolated low-voltage rig, check power balance, and use temperature distribution to locate abnormal contact resistance. For resistive losses in conductors and contacts, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 鬆動接點會把損耗集中在小區域，平均回路電阻的低解析度量測可能漏掉隨振動發生的間歇接觸。回到「導體接觸的電阻損失」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A loose contact concentrates loss in a small region; low-resolution mean resistance measurement can miss intermittent contact changes under vibration. Trace the input chain for resistive losses in conductors and contacts. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 直流電流增加兩倍時導線電阻損耗也只會增加兩倍~Doubling DC current merely doubles resistive conductor loss.
units.practice: 只把假想直流電流 I 從 200 改成 220 A（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.2 變為 1.452 kW。先說明「導體接觸的電阻損失」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only assumed direct current I from 200 to 220 A (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.2 to 1.452 kW. Explain the causal direction for resistive losses in conductors and contacts, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 輔助供電的跨區續航~Auxiliary backup across supply gaps
units.title: 輔助供電的跨區續航~Auxiliary backup across supply gaps
units.mechanism: 此單元只估控制和監視負載的定電壓備援時間，不代表車輛主牽引續航。先列可用能量比例，再討論負載尖峰與老化如何讓平均能量估算失準。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。~Estimate constant-voltage backup for controls and monitoring only, not main traction range. State usable-energy fraction before discussing surges and ageing that can defeat an average-energy estimate. Battery duration divides usable energy by load, so ampere-hours alone are insufficient without voltage. Temperature, ageing, discharge rate and cutoff affect usable fraction. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。公式 y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load，代入得 y=3.84 h。邊界：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W. Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.
units.verify: 量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。以「輔助供電的跨區續航」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately. For auxiliary backup across supply gaps, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 老化電池可能保有部分容量但內阻升高，啟動負載時掉壓使設備提早中止。回到「輔助供電的跨區續航」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An aged battery may retain some capacity while internal resistance rises, causing early shutdown during a starting load. Trace the input chain for auxiliary backup across supply gaps. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同~Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
units.practice: 只把固定負載 load 從 350 改成 385 W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3.84 變為 3.49091 h。先說明「輔助供電的跨區續航」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only constant load load from 350 to 385 W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3.84 to 3.49091 h. Explain the causal direction for auxiliary backup across supply gaps, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 車載轉換器散熱邊界~Cooling boundaries of onboard converters
units.title: 車載轉換器散熱邊界~Cooling boundaries of onboard converters
units.mechanism: 以平均損失功率估算轉換器穩態熱點，將環境溫度和散熱路徑分開改變。相同負載下的溫升差異可提示熱阻變化，但此模型不預測每次通過區段的瞬態峰值。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。~Estimate steady converter temperature from mean loss and vary ambient and heat paths separately. Temperature differences can reveal thermal-resistance changes, but the model does not predict each segment-transition transient. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. units.anchor: 供電區段與車載模式~Supply-section and onboard states
units.title: 供電區段與車載模式~Supply-section and onboard states
units.mechanism: 區分地面分段供電、架空線與車載儲能三種功能邊界，不把所有無架空線技術視為同一機制。用抽象狀態圖檢查模式資訊一致性，範例不重製廠商通電邏輯。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Distinguish ground segments, overhead supply and onboard storage instead of treating all catenary-free systems as one mechanism. Check mode consistency in an abstract graph without reproducing supplier energization logic. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.

units.anchor: 電源模式交接時序~Power-mode handoff timing
units.title: 電源模式交接時序~Power-mode handoff timing
units.mechanism: 把來源辨識、介面處理和狀態確認分成可測事件，追蹤訊息何時真正被採用。總延遲只是教學預算，不能取代電氣保護與能量緩衝的獨立驗證。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Split source identification, interface processing and confirmation into observable events and trace when information is used. The teaching timing budget does not replace independent protection or energy-buffer verification. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.

units.anchor: 備援電源共同原因~Common causes in backup supplies
units.title: 備援電源共同原因~Common causes in backup supplies
units.mechanism: 即使來源有兩種，轉換器、控制電源或冷卻路徑仍可能共用。先列共享介面再分析獨立失效，避免將設備數量增加誤認為風險自動歸零。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Two sources may still share converters, control power or cooling paths. Identify shared interfaces before analysing independent failures rather than assuming additional equipment eliminates risk. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes. Shared power, identical software defects or flooding at one location can affect both branches. More hardware does not replace evidence for separation, diversity and fault detection. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.

units.anchor: 潮濕污損與模式案例~Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases
units.title: 潮濕污損與模式案例~Wet, contaminated and mode-transition cases
units.mechanism: 把環境狀態與供電模式分成測試軸，不以乾燥正常運轉代表全部使用範圍。追溯每項需求的證據與未測邊界，數值算例不作為實際通電允許條件。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Treat environmental condition and power mode as separate test axes rather than generalizing from dry normal operation. Trace requirement evidence and untested boundaries without using example values as energization permissions. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. units.anchor: 線路服務與設備修復~Line service and equipment recovery
units.title: 線路服務與設備修復~Line service and equipment recovery
units.mechanism: 分開電源局部退出、車輛降級與全線停駛，才能解釋同樣故障對服務的不同影響。核對修復與恢復服務的時間點，避免可用度漂亮卻遮蔽功能受限。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Distinguish local supply withdrawal, degraded vehicles and line suspension to explain different service consequences. Audit repair and service-restoration times so attractive availability cannot conceal reduced functionality. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.verify: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「線路服務與設備修復」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For line service and equipment recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Trace the input chain for line service and equipment recovery. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的~High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
units.practice: 只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「線路服務與設備修復」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for line service and equipment recovery, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：輪周功率與電源需求採 m=180000 kg；本課公式結果 1800 kW，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for wheel power and supply demand: m=180000 kg; this model gives 1800 kW, not a field rating.
教學假設：回生能量與接收邊界採 m=180000 kg；本課公式結果 8.47 kWh，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for regeneration and receiving boundaries: m=180000 kg; this model gives 8.47 kWh, not a field rating.
教學假設：導體接觸的電阻損失採 I=200 A；本課公式結果 1.2 kW，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for resistive losses in conductors and contacts: I=200 A; this model gives 1.2 kW, not a field rating.
教學假設：輔助供電的跨區續航採 capacity=80 Ah；本課公式結果 3.84 h，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for auxiliary backup across supply gaps: capacity=80 Ah; this model gives 3.84 h, not a field rating.
教學假設：車載轉換器散熱邊界採 P=900 W；本課公式結果 61.5 degC，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for cooling boundaries of onboard converters: P=900 W; this model gives 61.5 degC, not a field rating.
教學假設：供電區段與車載模式採 bits=8 bits；本課公式結果 256 states，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for supply-section and onboard states: bits=8 bits; this model gives 256 states, not a field rating.
